title: BulkSeatStateChanged
description: Published by Seat Inventory Service for bulk state transitions affecting multiple seats in a single operation: EVENT_CANCELLED, VENUE_SUSPENDED, ADMIN_BLOCKED, ADMIN_UNBLOCKED. A single message may contain thousands of seatIds. Consumers must handle large affectedSeatIds arrays without OOM (stream/batch process — do not load all into memory at once).

eventId.description: Kafka partition key. All bulk changes for one event on one partition.

affectedSeatIds.description: All seat IDs that transitioned in this batch. For large events this may be thousands of entries. Consumers must batch-process, not load all into memory.

initiatedByUserId.description: Admin user ID who triggered the bulk operation. Present for ADMIN_BLOCKED and ADMIN_UNBLOCKED.
